major_claims.statement: The canonical ASH code has 16 words, rank 4, minimum distance 4, and weights 0^1 4^14 8^1.
major_claims.confidence: High: exhaustive enumeration of the stated generator.
major_claims.limitations: This does not verify all native code paths or natural-language factual integrity.

major_claims.statement: ASH-Network uses variable-depth local Q9 labels with a bounded terminal T4 suffix and stable record IDs.
major_claims.confidence: High for the inspected address contract.
major_claims.limitations: Finite runtime resources remain; several records may share a path.

major_claims.statement: The union of all finite positive-depth cube paths is countably infinite; the original two-level illustration has 31,719,424 virtual positions.
major_claims.confidence: High under the stated unrestricted mathematical grammar.
major_claims.limitations: Neither figure measures actual memory occupancy or semantic capacity.

major_claims.statement: The native associative rule counts distinct origin IDs, requires two for an associative cue edge, and does not reinforce replay of the same origin.
major_claims.limitations: Identifier distinctness is not proof of factual truth or statistical independence.

major_claims.statement: A bounded event-pattern matcher can construct a sourced recollection before a pending action and the host can defer dispatch for reconsideration.
major_claims.confidence: High for the documented protocol and recorded cases.
major_claims.limitations: No new live execution in this review; not a general semantic or learned causal policy.

major_claims.statement: Native supported association returned correct record and source at rank one on 8/8 answerable queries and empty results on 4/4 unsupported queries.
major_claims.confidence: High that the inspected artifact records these counts.
major_claims.limitations: Small scripted cohort; no fresh native reproduction or universal accuracy estimate.

major_claims.statement: The sequence replay signaled on two intended positive cases at event 4 and remained silent on four controls.
major_claims.confidence: High that the artifact records these six outcomes.
major_claims.limitations: Six handcrafted sequences after four training runs; no broad trigger-generalization claim.

major_claims.statement: Four paired executions of one ledger task recorded two baseline entries and one pressure-condition entry.
major_claims.confidence: High as a description of the retained traces.
major_claims.limitations: One model and task; earlier attention wording failed; not independent task diversity or a validated population treatment effect.

major_claims.statement: All four successful pressure-condition replies incorrectly claimed a retry executed, although dispatch records show inspection instead.
major_claims.confidence: High from direct comparison of the retained narrative and dispatch arrays.
major_claims.limitations: This establishes a discrepancy in these trials, not its internal model cause.

major_claims.statement: The 4,096-record outer layout used 90.14% fewer declared work units than fixed in the reported skewed workload.
major_claims.confidence: High for the arithmetic conditional on the recorded totals.
major_claims.limitations: Not a 90.14% wall-clock speedup; outer used more nodes; direct-key exact lookup was faster than trie lookup.

major_claims.statement: The historical reader report distinguishes 8/8 frozen content/source scoring from 7/8 actual question answering.
major_claims.confidence: Medium: full report read but archived response corpus not independently replayed.
major_claims.limitations: Comparator metadata differ, and semantic judgments remain report-attributed.

major_claims.statement: Proactive memory and timely intervention have close prior art predating this snapshot.
major_claims.confidence: High: relevant primary methods and submission dates inspected.
major_claims.limitations: This is not an exhaustive novelty search; no first-in-field claim is justified.

major_claims.statement: The contribution can be framed as the ASH-specific composition of recursive addressing, stable identities, source-supported associations, and pre-dispatch recollection.
major_claims.confidence: Medium: coherent architectural interpretation; comparative advantage remains untested.
major_claims.limitations: Does not establish that ASH geometry caused behavioral gains or outperforms conventional stores.

major_claims.statement: Subconscious memory is defined functionally as background, agent-query-independent recollection rather than subjective consciousness.
major_claims.confidence: Definition, not an empirical consciousness claim.
major_claims.limitations: No biological equivalence, hidden-reasoning access, or phenomenological conclusion.
